items.t: Uber Technologies (UBER) Starts Commercial Drone Food Deliveries In Texas With 1 Million Daily Goal
items.sum: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) and Zipline have begun commercial drone food deliveries in Texas, expanding Uber's logistics footprint beyond road couriers. The partners are targeting the capacity to handle up to one million drone deliveries per day by 2029 across U.S. cities.
